variants.text: A young adult with an oval face, almond-shaped eyes, and short blonde hair pulled back.
A young adult with an oval face, medium-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, a straight nose, and short blonde hair pulled straight back.

Young adult with an oval face, moderately defined bone structure, and a rounded chin. Features include medium-thickness soft-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with double eyelid creases, a straight nose with a rounded tip, and medium-width mouth. The hair is short and blonde, pulled straight back from a rounded hairline with slight temporal recession.
This is a young woman with an oval-shaped face and short blonde hair that is pulled straight back. She has natural-looking eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, and a straight nose.
